title: Proper forget-supports normalization of one relative Kunneth route
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and let p:W→X, q:W→Y, f:X→S, g:Y→S form an arbitrary cartesian square. Let h:W→S with q;g=h and assume f,g,q,h proper. For arbitrary E∈D(X_et,A), K∈D(Y_et,A), let r be the specifically constructed native properSupportedKunnethRoute from Rh!(p*E⊗q*K) to Rf!E⊗Rg!K. Let c_a:Ra!→Ra* be the canonical proper comparison of [def-sp-unbounded-proper-shriek-star-comparison]. Then r⁻¹;c_h = (c_f⊗c_g);κ, where κ is the independently defined ordinary Kunneth map of [def-kun-kunneth-map] with common structural map h. The auxiliary properKunnethInput is the explicit tensor of c_f and c_g, not an arbitrary chosen isomorphism. Only one relative route is normalized; no coordinate-interchange equality is assumed.

proof.text: Expand the inverse of the constructed native properSupportedKunnethRoute. Naturality moves the proper comparisons through the tensor symmetries. Replace its two supported projection maps with ordinary projection maps using the proved projectionMap_comp_rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar.

The private exchange_supports expands the supported exchange and applies the two existing source-library compactification forget-supports comparison equations; this proves the full exchange comparison. The specified compositor is normalized by lem-sf-proper-shriek-compositor-supports, the sole remaining obligation. Naturality of the proper comparison for g and the projection coincidence then move both comparisons to the input.

The generic kunnethMap_symmetricFactorization proves the precise symmetric ordinary projection/exchange/compositor formula from native Kunneth symmetry and the source-library flipped factorization. Substitute it and use bifunctor naturality to collect the two source proper comparisons.

Apply the abstract proper Kunneth normalization diagram. Its compositor square is properShriekComp_comp_forgetSupports; its inner and projection squares are the native support-comparison equations proved above; projection and tensor naturality give the next two squares; the proved ordinary symmetric factorization is the last square. Use the inverse-route component equation to identify the abstract left-hand composite.

theorem properRelativeKunneth_comp_forgetSupports {S X Y W : Scheme.{u}}
    {p : W ⟶ X} {q : W ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ S}
    (sq : IsPullback p q f g) (h : W ⟶ S) (w : q ≫ g = h)
    [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsProper q] [IsProper h]
    (E : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (properSupportedKunnethRoute A sq h w E K).inv ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).hom.app
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) W).obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj E)).obj
              ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)) =
      (properKunnethInput A f g E K).hom ≫
        kunnethMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p q f g h (sq.w.trans w) w E K
